resources.string: Google Maps estimates the battery left at arrival with a model of the MG4 (speed, cold, climate) instead of the car\'s average consumption.

What it does: Google Maps estimates the battery left at your destination from a description of the car, instead of the car's current average consumption. Driving fast, the cold and the heating then count.

How: DiAuto tells Maps how the car resists moving (rolling, raised in the cold, and air), and how much power the climate and electronics use at each outside temperature. Google's servers work out the energy of each part of the route, with the expected speed, traffic and climb.

Data used: the car version (battery setting), the battery level and capacity, the outside temperature and whether the climate is on. They only go to your phone, like the battery level today.

Experimental: the values are estimates, the forecast can be off until they are calibrated.
